Lyra 0.0.1 - AI Instance Core Model
Represents the user-created AI instance with identity, personality, memory, and state.
"""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional

class AIInstance:
    """Represents a single AI instance created by the user."""
    
    def __init__(self, ai_name: str = "AI"):
        self.ai_name = ai_name
        self.identity = {
            "created": False,
            "user_identity_preference": None
        }
        self.personality = {
            "selected": None,
            "custom_description": None
        }  
        self.model_config = {
            "selected_model": None,
            "capabilities": []
        }
        self.memory = {}
        self.creation_timestamp = None
        
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert instance to dictionary for persistence."""
        return {
            "ai_name": self.ai_name,
            "identity": self.identity,
            "personality": self.personality,
            "model_config": self.model_config,
            "memory": self.memory,
            "creation_timestamp": self.creation_timestamp
        }
        
    def from_dict(self, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Load instance from dictionary."""
        self.ai_name = data.get("ai_name", "AI")
        self.identity = data.get("identity", {"created": False})
        self.personality = data.get("personality", {})
        self.model_config = data.get("model_config", {})
        self.memory = data.get("memory", {})
        self.creation_timestamp = data.get("creation_timestamp")
        
    def is_complete(self) -> bool:
        """Check if AI has complete onboarding state."""
        return (self.identity.get("created") and 
                self.personality.get("selected") is not None)
                
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"AIInstance(name='{self.ai_name}', identity={self.identity}, personality={self.personality})""}
